class_imbalance_note: 'other' is 363/552 (66%) of all questions. 7 domains (civil_registration, constitutional, cybercrime, local_government, money_recovery, road_transport, tenancy) total 23/552 (4%) questions COMBINED across the entire gold pool, not just this split -- 1-6 examples each. v3 vs v2: NB now fits a uniform class prior (was the learned ~66%-other prior) and both RNNs now train with balanced_class_weights cross-entropy (was unweighted) -- LogReg already had class_weight='balanced' in v2. This corrects imbalance the model can act on. The merged_rare_domains variant (7 thinnest domains folded into 'rare_other') isolates what's left: if macro-F1 there is still far below 1.0, the ceiling is data volume, not model capacity, and no further reweighting changes that.
